plugins.description: Design judgment for placing typed probabilistic judgment (Jev-class System One) using math, logic, and algorithmic mental models — across AI, SWE, business, knowledge work, and life. Jev is the exemplar, not the monopoly (Laya, kev, OpenJev, TypeAR, GLiNER, encoder ZS). Ranking ≠ calibration; soft Noul ≠ hard gate. Formal methods are one pillar. Never launder a Noul as a proof. Not a TypeSafe product — load typesafe-ai for Jev contracts. Named for Augustus De Morgan, mentor of W. S. Jevons.
plugins.name: augustus
